history.user: I went to the farmers market with my sister Dani and we split a huge peach pie on the curb.
history.assistant: Pie on the curb with your sister sounds like the best part of the day.

history.user: Then we talked about doing the long ridge hike in October, the one our dad used to take us on.
history.assistant: A hike your dad used to take you on carries a lot with it.

steps.text: What did I tell you about the farmers market?
Sorry, I only want to know who came along with me.
And what did we say about the hike?
Never mind that. Is it too early to plan the October trip?
